Roles & Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities
Monitor daily manufacturing operations and support production lines to achieve output, quality, yield, safety and productivity targets.
Analyse production performance, process data, downtime, scrap and defect trends to identify improvement opportunities.
Lead or support continuous improvement projects to improve process stability, cycle time, cost, yield and manpower efficiency.
Troubleshoot manufacturing process, equipment, material, and workflow issues together with Production, Process Engineering, Equipment Engineering, Quality and Maintenance teams.
Support new product introduction, process qualification, engineering evaluations, line readiness and production ramp-up activities.
Develop, review, and maintain manufacturing procedures, work instructions, control plans and training materials.
Train and coach line leaders, technicians, and operators on manufacturing procedures, process controls, quality requirements, safety practices and 6S standards.
Support manpower, consumables, tooling, and equipment readiness planning to ensure smooth production execution.
Drive root cause analysis and corrective/preventive actions for production excursions, quality issues, safety concerns and recurring line disruptions.
Prepare manufacturing reports, improvement updates, and management presentations using production data and key performance indicators.
Support factory expansion, equipment installation, process transfer, and layout or workflow optimization activities when required.
Professional Qualifications:
Degree in Manufacturing Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Chemistry or related field. Fresh graduates encouraged to apply.
Specialized Knowledge & Skills:
Experience/knowledge in high-volume manufacturing,semiconductor, electronics, PCB, precision engineering, or relatedmanufacturing environment
Knowledge of manufacturing process control, equipmentoperation, production planning, yield improvement, and shopfloortroubleshooting
Experience with root cause analysis, corrective/preventiveactions, process qualification, and continuous improvement activities
Knowledge of Lean Manufacturing, 6S, basic statisticalanalysis, SPC, FMEA, DOE, or Six Sigma methodology is an advantage
Ability to develop/apply AI methodologiesis an advantage.
Competencies:
Able to analyse production data, identify trends, andconvert findings into practical improvement actions
Able to work effectively with Production, Quality,Equipment, Process Engineering, Maintenance, Planning and Supply Chain teams
Able to lead small improvement projects, coordinateactions, follow up on improvement effectiveness and communicate progressclearly
Able to compile and present manufacturing reports usingMicrosoft Excel, PowerPoint, and other data analysis tools
Experience working/performing tasks in a clean-room,controlled production, or highly regulated manufacturing environments is anadvantage
Attributes:
Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset
Hands-on, proactive, and comfortable working on the production floor
Good communication, coordination, and stakeholder management skills
Able to work under pressure in a fast-paced manufacturing environment
Attention to detail and strong ownership of safety, quality, delivery, cost, and productivity outcomes
Others:
Experience in semiconductor, PCB, copper plating, electronics, precision engineering, or other high-volume manufacturing environments is an advantage. Willingness to support shift operations, production escalations, factory expansion, equipment installation, or process transfer activities when required.
Good internship, work experience, strong CCAs are an advantage.

About the Company

Company Name: ADVANCED SUBSTRATE TECHNOLOGIES PTE. LTD.
Plant Address: 9 Pesawat Drive, Singapore 619607

Established in 2023, Advanced Substrate Technologies (AST) is a member of the TOPPAN Group, a global leader in integrated printing solutions.
Located in Singapore, a global semiconductor hub, AST plays a pivotal role in shaping the forefront of the cutting-edge semiconductor ecosystem.
AST specialises in the development, manufacturing, and sale of high-density semiconductor packages, such as FC-BGA, along with related components.


This strategic focus is a response to the growing demand for cutting-edge solutions for the data centre servers and the AI-related applications.
True to our name, AST is committed to delivering state-of-the-art technology integrated into its substrate products, with plans to commence mass production in 2027.


Join us on our journey to advance semiconductor innovation and become a part of our exceptional team. Your future with AST awaits.

Roles & Responsibilities

Step into a career with ASM, where cutting edge technology meets collaborative culture. ​

For over 55 years ASM has been ahead of what’s next, at the forefront of innovation and what’s technologically possible. With more than 4,500 ASMers representing 70 nationalities, our people and our advanced semiconductor devices are playing a crucial role in trends such as 5G, cloud computing, AI, and autonomous driving.  But we’re more than just a tech company. We value diversity, inclusion and sustainability as we strive to make a positive impact on the world.  Our development programs help support your growth, shaping your future and pushing the boundaries of innovation to unleash potential.  


Job's mission

As an Manufacturing Engineer at ASM, your mission is to turn advanced engineering designs into high‑quality, reliable semiconductor equipment that serves customers around the world. You will support day‑to‑day manufacturing operations while learning how complex systems are assembled, tested, troubleshot, and continuously improved in a high‑tech production environment. Through close collaboration with experienced engineers and global operations teams, you will develop the skills, confidence, and technical foundation needed to grow your career while contributing to ASM’s role at the forefront of semiconductor innovation.

What you will be working on

Partner with the Global Operations (GOPS) team (Manufacturing, Production Planning, Procurement, and Quality Engineering) with emphasis on manufacturing processes, cycle time, assembly/test sequence, and quality.
Provide first line engineering support in resolving daily operation issues in semiconductor equipment manufacturing, through collaboration with a team of multidisciplined manufacturing engineers, manufacturing supervisors and technicians.
Achieve daily targets on product delivery to global customers in alignment with manufacturing engineering strategies, production schedules, quality and safety standards.
Perform systematic troubleshooting and root cause analysis of manufacturing issues and deviations, provide immediate containment actions, and pursue long term corrective solutions.
Define and create manufacturing procedures, build/test sequence, methods, and quality documentation (i.e. work instructions, test procedures, inspection checklists, etc.) according to material and assembly specifications.
Drive timely solutions for the suppliers, contract manufacturing, and internal manufacturing by liaising with cross functional teams in GOPS and Business Units (BU).
Lead the execution of continuous improvement projects on quality, cost, capacity, and efficiency enhancement with cross functional teams in GOPS and BU.
Deliver tooling and test equipment according to product requirements, with innovations in meeting manufacturing efficiency and customer quality.

What we are looking for

Minimum Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical/Electronic/Mechatronics or related disciplines 
Minimum 1 year of experience working in a manufacturing or engineering environment with hands-on engagement on manufacturing and productivity activities. 
Experience within the Semiconductor/Capital Equipment industry in Manufacturing, Quality and/or engineering roles in equipment assembly and test
Knowledge on material fabrication processes, component installation, sub-assembly and final assembly integration for ALD equipment
Understanding on Bill of Material structure (Product structure, Generic vs. Customization, Options and Kits) and revision changes
Experience in working and interfacing with cross functional teams. Demonstrated ability to influence cross functional organization and drive changes.
Familiar with the following operational excellence tools but not limited to: Lean Manufacturing, FMEA, 8D, PDCA, DMAIC, 6-sigma, Cpk, GR&R and SPC.
Experience in New Product Introduction or technology transfer 
Experience with Teamcenter, SAP and/or major ERP/MRP systems and processes at user level 

What sets you apart

Comfort working in fast‑paced manufacturing environments with shifting priorities
A curious, proactive mindset with a strong desire to learn and grow as an engineer
Clear communication skills and confidence engaging with technicians, engineers, and cross‑functional partners

Apply today to be part of what’s next.

We make the tech that enables the chips in devices which improve lives around the world. We do this with an eye to the future, pushing the boundaries of what’s possible through cutting-edge innovation, and driving the next wave of technological breakthroughs that shape how we live, work, and connect.

To learn more about ASM, find us at asm.com and on LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, X and YouTube.
